proposal.summary: The Genexis Platinum-4410 v2.1 router's web login page (http://192.168.1.1/cgi-bin/index2.asp) exposes plaintext passwords for user accounts (Admin, GENEXIS, user3) in the page source, allowing an attacker who can access the page to obtain credentials and potentially control the device.
proposal.cwe_quote: Genexis Platinum-4410 v2.1 Home Gateway Router discloses passwords of each users(Admin,GENEXIS,user3) in plain text behind login page source “http://192.168.1.1/cgi-bin/index2.asp".

AV.quote: There we can found passwords for each login accounts in clear text.

PR.quote: There we can found passwords for each login accounts in clear text.

C.quote: This could potentially allow a remote attacker access sensitive information and perform actions such as reset router, changing passwords, upload malicious firmware etc.

I.quote: This could potentially allow a remote attacker access sensitive information and perform actions such as reset router, changing passwords, upload malicious firmware etc.

A.quote: This could potentially allow a remote attacker access sensitive information and perform actions such as reset router, changing passwords, upload malicious firmware etc.

proposal.recommended_next_step: Retrieve the referenced page source to confirm the presence of plaintext credentials and reproduce the disclosure; if confirmed, notify vendor to remove credentials from client-side code and require storing secrets server-side and rotating affected passwords.
